storage.method: Structured rows in Supabase tables (resources, activities, questions)
storage.evidence: Graph asset path stored inside resources.content JSON. But mig_1_tables.sql has NO image/asset column — resources only has (id, specification_point_id, title, created_at). The 'content' column was added ad-hoc outside migrations.

relationships.method: Foreign keys in SQL + relationship map in JSON content
relationships.evidence: 5 relationships mapped: Q4→graph, Q5a→table_q5, Q5b→eq_acceleration, Q6a→eq_v2_uas, Q4b→eq_avg_speed

retriever.method: SQL: SELECT * FROM resources WHERE id = ?
retriever.evidence: Relational retrieval finds Q4 and its linked graph asset PATH. But SQL cannot interpret graph pixel values — it returns the asset reference, not the graph's meaning. An LLM with vision is still needed to read values from the graph image.

backend_api.method: FastAPI endpoint returns resources.content JSON to frontend
backend_api.evidence: FastAPI would return the JSON content containing graph path. But there is NO endpoint to serve the graph image itself. The path points to a local filesystem location the frontend cannot access.

frontend.evidence: HybridDocumentViewer.jsx (lines 89-309) has two modes: (1) Document mode renders content_markdown via ReactMarkdown — but content_markdown is NULL → 'Markdown Unavailable' placeholder (line 227-231). (2) Interactive mode renders concept nodes as clickable cards (lines 254-284) with formula in ConceptPopup (lines 53-62). There is NO tag anywhere in the component. Graph assets cannot be displayed.

experiment_answers.1_reconstruct_worksheet: NO — text is preserved but document layout is lost
experiment_answers.2_graphs_preserved: PARTIAL — graph image extracted and path stored, but frontend CANNOT render it (no tag in viewer)
experiment_answers.3_diagrams_preserved: NO — no diagram rendering capability in viewer
experiment_answers.4_equations_preserved: YES — LaTeX equations render via KaTeX in concept popups
experiment_answers.5_tables_preserved: NO — data table content stored in JSON but viewer has no table rendering component
experiment_answers.6_practical_assets_preserved: PARTIAL — table data stored but blank plotting grid on page 3 not extracted
experiment_answers.7_ai_answer_graph_questions: NO — relational retrieval returns graph path but cannot compute values from graph pixels
experiment_answers.8_frontend_render_assets: NO — viewer renders concept cards and equations only; no graph, table, or diagram rendering
experiment_answers.9_information_lost: YES — graph visual, table structure, document layout, blank plotting grid, and table-to-question visual linkage are all lost

storage.method: Same structured rows + embedding vectors in pgvector column
storage.schema_addition: ALTER TABLE resources ADD COLUMN embedding vector(1536) — requires pgvector extension
storage.evidence: Same structured output stored. pgvector adds embedding column for semantic search. Graph asset path still in JSON content. The storage gap (no image column) is identical to Pipeline A.

embeddings.method: Text chunks embedded (simulated 1536-dim, real would use text-embedding-3-small or NVIDIA Nemotron)
embeddings.evidence: 7 chunks created (one per question). Q4 chunk text includes '[Linked graph: page2_distance_time_graph]' and metadata.linked_graph field. The graph REFERENCE is embedded, but the graph IMAGE itself cannot be embedded in a text vector.

relationships.method: Same FK relationships + semantic similarity for discovery
relationships.evidence: Same 5 relationships. pgvector adds ability to find SIMILAR questions but does not change relationship storage.

retriever.method: SELECT * FROM resources ORDER BY embedding <=> $query_vec LIMIT 5
retriever.semantic_advantage: Better at finding Q4 when user query is paraphrased (e.g., 'how fast did Bolt run' finds Q4 without exact keyword match)
retriever.evidence: Semantic search is better at FINDING the right question chunk. But once found, it retrieves the same graph asset PATH. pgvector cannot interpret graph pixel values — it operates on text embeddings only. The bottleneck (graph interpretation) is IDENTICAL to Pipeline A.

backend_api.method: FastAPI calls Supabase RPC for pgvector similarity search, returns chunks + metadata
backend_api.evidence: API would return semantically matched chunks with graph path in metadata. Same gap: no endpoint to serve graph image bytes to frontend.

frontend.evidence: Pipeline B uses the SAME frontend viewer. Adding pgvector changes the RETRIEVAL mechanism but the RENDERING layer is unchanged. The graph still cannot be displayed because HybridDocumentViewer has no rendering capability (lines 89-309, no image tag found).
